name: debut-loop
description: Debut Loop! — Reigns식 스와이프 + 로그라이크 아이돌 게임

scripts.build:single: tsc --noEmit && VITE_CHEATS=1 vite build --config vite.single.config.ts && node scripts/singlefile.mjs
scripts.apk:sync: tsc --noEmit && VITE_CHEATS=1 vite build && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run apk:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:sync:release: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cap sync android
scripts.apk:release: npm run apk:sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
